blurb: an eventual, non-authoritative play-money market on how long dontpressit.bisks.net's current round survives before someone presses the button and graduates it: pari-mutuel odds across six time buckets, reconciled when the Worker observes a new round, no login. house rule, right up top: betting here and then going to press the button yourself to cash in is match-fixing.
